# Numbers too large to be finite as ids

1e400, a hex integer of 300 digits, an octal integer of 400 digits and a decimal integer of 5,000 digits are all
too large to be finite, so each is read as .inf is: not a string, so not an id. 0x8000000000000000 is a number
(2 to the power 63), not a string. So "1e400" names nothing (C006).
